field_evidence.title: Studyinfo application target

field_mappings.label: Application route (rolling admission only when explicitly named)

field_evidence.source_temporal_context: Studyinfo application-target JSON publishes source-native application windows, start terms and document-delivery dates. These are application and registry dates; no academic cycle is inferred.
field_evidence.schema_context: This Finnish National Agency for Education Studyinfo record is matched by the exact hakukohde OID. Map rolling_admission only when the source hakuNimi or target name explicitly contains Rolling admission; do not infer rolling admission from a generic separate-application route. The materialized pohjakoulutusvaatimus value is one source-native prior-education option and may support minimum_degree only for a programme whose target degree makes that field applicable; emit that one literal English label. For minimum_degree, evidence MUST copy the complete continuous line beginning `Required prior education (minimum degree requirement):`; an evidence span containing only the degree label is insufficient. The materialized liitteet value is one source-native application-document name; emit required_documents as that literal string only, never as a structured object and never as a list assembled from other source records. Preserve required versus conditional/post-offer language only when it is in the same exact evidence span. Ignore registry publication markers completely: they are not admissions status. Do not map application deadlines to priority/international/funding types without an explicit label.

external_providers.reason: Official Finnish Studyinfo/Opintopolku backend exposes exact application-target records with source-native prior-education requirements, document attachments, and explicitly named rolling-admission routes.

field_evidence.source_temporal_context: Studyinfo selection-criteria JSON carries source-native application and programme text. Academic cycle may be emitted only when the matched text explicitly labels an academic year or admissions year; modified/timestamp metadata is not a cycle.
field_evidence.schema_context: This Finnish National Agency for Education Studyinfo record is matched by the exact valintaperuste id. Emit standardized_tests only for an explicitly named standardized admission test or threshold (for example GMAT/GRE/SAT); a generic course score is not a test requirement. For ielts_overall and toefl, emit only the exact named minimum overall threshold from metadata.hakukelpoisuus; do not derive subscores or treat a general English-language statement as numeric evidence. Emit work_experience only when metadata.hakukelpoisuus explicitly requires work experience and preserve its duration/field wording. Emit scholarships only for an explicit scholarship, waiver, grant or funding policy in metadata.lisatiedot; do not turn tuition amounts or a linked page into an award, amount or eligibility. Emit academic_cycle only from an explicit admissions/academic-year label in the same evidence; never use modified, timestamp, application dates or start terms to invent one. Preserve all source text and programme scope; no value is hard-coded.

external_providers.reason: Official Finnish Studyinfo selection-criteria JSON publishes programme-specific language thresholds, standardized-test thresholds, work-experience eligibility and explicit scholarship policy where present.
